up: Return canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, and exact activity values for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL5606461. Include the standard relation, standard value, and standard units.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM assays assy JOIN activities a ON assy.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE assy.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5606461'
